name: Revelio
description: A basic revelation charm. Reveals concealed objects and passages. Standard investigative spell taught in Year 2.
effect: Hidden objects in the immediate area become visible for a short duration.

name: Lumos Maxima
description: An enhanced illumination charm. Floods a dark area with bright magical light, revealing details invisible in ordinary candlelight.
effect: The area is brightly illuminated. Details become visible that were hidden in shadow.

name: Specialis Revelio
description: A specialized examination charm. Reveals magical properties, composition, and traces of spells affecting an object.
effect: The object's magical composition becomes apparent. Traces of potions or enchantments are revealed.

name: Memoria Vestigium
description: An advanced trace spell. Reads the recent magical memory of an object or surface — not full legilimency, but a directional impression of who handled it and when. Requires focused concentration.
effect: A brief impression of recent activity at this location or object surfaces in your mind — shapes, movement, emotional residue.
